# ReadonlyPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on this page that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `ReadonlyElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## "Read-only Inputs" form (in the page)

- **"Text field is read-only"**: checkbox. In `ReadonlyElements` as `TEXT_FIELD_IS_READ_ONLY_CHECKBOX`: `check().textFieldIsReadOnly()`.
- **(no words: an icon)**: text field. In `ReadonlyElements` as `TEXT_FIELD_INPUT`: `enter().textField(...)`.
- **"Always read-only"**: text field. In `ReadonlyElements` as `ALWAYS_READ_ONLY_INPUT`: `enter().alwaysReadOnly(...)`.
- **"Disabled (not the same as read-only)"**: text field. In `ReadonlyElements` as `DISABLED_NOT_THE_SAME_AS_INPUT`: `enter().disabledNotTheSameAs(...)`.
